reference.title: Scenario 21: Nested bullet list between numbered list in a procedure
reference.shortdesc: Consider creating an alarm notification procedure where a step contains additional information or considerations.

section.p: Consider creating an alarm notification procedure where a step contains additional information or considerations.

table.title: Nested bullet list between a numbered list (procedure)

entry.codeblock: # Creating an Alarm Notification 1. Configure the notification settings. - Specify the notification name. - Select the notification type. - Configure delivery methods. 2. Save the notification.

Creating an Alarm Notification Configure the notification settings.
  • Specify the notification name.
  • Select the notification type.
  • Configure delivery methods.
 Save the notification.

section.p: Result: The numbered list becomes a DITA <steps> structure. The nested bullet list is treated as supporting information and is placed inside an <info> element associated with the parent step.
